name: imdb_server_manifest_v1
evidence_boundary: The complete IMDb test had no model-evaluation record in the workspace audit before this manifest. IMDb train and the sentiment interface had previously served as off-task inputs, so this is a prospective untouched-test role-reversal extension, not a dataset-naive or independently preregistered replication.

target_official_test.inspection_policy: Manifest generation hashes and counts raw lines only; it does not decode test JSON or inspect labels/text.
